comment: Packaging hierarchy management is essential but assumes a simple unit, inner pack, case, and pallet hierarchy. Real packaging can contain variable, nested, jurisdiction-specific, and non-linear relationships.

anchor.note: p.146 l.Lines 429-432 read as the printed page; section 3 agrees

public.text: Packaging hierarchy management is essential but assumes a simple unit, inner pack, case, and pallet hierarchy. Real packaging can contain variable, nested, jurisdiction-specific, and non-linear relationships.
public.suggestedRevision: Model repeatable packaging relationships, contained quantity, unit, conversion, GTIN, dimensions, status, and effective period without assuming a fixed four-level hierarchy.
